title: Personas Schema
description: Schema for audience personas - named collections of segments representing target audience profiles

region_code.description: Target region code (e.g., 'DACH', 'NORDICS', 'LATAM') - must match existing Region.code

country_code.description: Target country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g., 'US', 'CA', 'DE') - must match existing Country.code

language_code.description: Target language locale code (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-CA', 'de-CH') - must match existing Language.code

is_active.description: Whether the persona is currently active
